steps.label: Protection headers by platform
steps.text: The platform predicts who sends protection (score {{h08-field.auc_platform}}), the firm's own features hardly do (score {{h08-field.auc_firm}}).
steps.claim: On Apache they are missing at {{h08-field.zero_apache}}, behind Cloudflare at {{h08-field.zero_cloudflare}}.

steps.label: The same server version
steps.text: Of these {{h08-field.banner_sites}} websites, {{h08-field.banner_enforced}} enforce the mail protection rule DMARC, of all others {{h08-field.other_enforced}}.
steps.claim: Same server version, strikingly often the same mail rule.

steps.label: Strictly set DMARC rules
steps.text: Strict means: mail without proof of sender is rejected (DMARC). That fits shared defaults, we have not tested it.
steps.claim: Of {{h08-field.enforced_all}} strict mail rules, {{h08-field.enforced_share_banner}} come from just {{h08-field.banner_sites}} websites.
